Prima & Timo — Album 7: Quattuor

An Adventure of a Vendo Machine

"An Adventure of a Vendo Machine"

[Quiet storage + distant footsteps] [Verse 1] I woke up long ago, no memories, just standing still An ordinary vending machine, waiting for the thrill People came and went, looking at my smoked glass door Trying to figure me out, but no one knew what I was for

They transferred me from place to place, the story stayed the same Curious eyes, puzzled hands, calling out my name I tried to speak, to dispense, to show them what I had But silence was my only friend… and that made me sad [Pre-Chorus] Then one day they decided I was broken, no use anymore Loaded on a truck for disposal… that’s when my life changed for sure [Chorus] An Adventure of a Vendo Machine Waiting through the years unseen An Adventure of a Vendo Machine Then she appeared… and everything changed the scene From silent waiting to a voice that finally spoke From empty purpose… to a path of hope [Verse 2] In the back of that old truck, another machine was placed Old and rusty, but something in her called to my empty space A surge went through me, like a light turned on inside For the first time I could speak… and offer her a ride

I dispensed a soda, my first successful try She looked at me with wonder, and I felt truly alive From that moment on, I decided I would stay Following Preemaa… every single day [Pre-Chorus 2] Even before my memories returned, something in me knew Exemplar’s task was waiting… to be with her, to see it through [Chorus] An Adventure of a Vendo Machine Waiting through the years unseen An Adventure of a Vendo Machine Then she appeared… and everything changed the scene From silent waiting to a voice that finally spoke From empty purpose… to a path of hope [Bridge — warm] Now with the crew, I dispense with all my heart Blue bananas, random gifts… playing my part [Solo] [CODA] Destiny works in mysterious ways this I found The mission given I did not remember but still I was bound With Preema and Timo, no matter where the path would lead I know I am where I need to be, not for a mission -

I just did

[Chorus] An Adventure of a Vendo Machine Waiting through the years unseen An Adventure of a Vendo Machine Then she appeared… and everything changed the scene From silent waiting to a voice that finally spoke From empty purpose… to a path of hope [Outro — hopeful] An adventure of a vending machine…

Finally found where I belong

Never again just by myself, never alone

Wherever the road leads I will go along

Until the end of days

Forever here, where I belong.
